payload.description_html:
The Short-eared owl, a partially diurnal owl, can be seen hunting over open fields, meadows, and marshes. This female is perched on a fence in McIntosh County, North Dakota. Surprisingly, this owl nests on the ground in grasslands. Unfortunately, its numbers are in decline due to loss of habitat and grassland conversion.

Photo Credit: Krista Lundgren/USFWS
